rows.TEXT: The Vertigo spell is believed to have been lost forever. The spell gives the possessor the power to defeat  his enemies.

We first came to Grand Phantasy to destroy the population of witches. We buried them in two grave yards. From time to time their is a strange feeling in the air. The Phantasmals have been acting strangely almost as though they are under a spell.
You may have won this battle but you will never, never win the war! Elyza will avenge us and Vynn Nova will live once again!
How did you get by our defenses? It doesn't matter now, all that matters is that Lord Val has failed us. Now Grand Phantasy will never be free from the evils growing within here.
Elyza is immune to all your little spells and tricks. I would not try to use fire, death or mind control. The best way to defeat Elyza is with brute force.
Grand Phantasy is being exploited and corrupted. As painful as it may be we will sacrifice Grand Phantasy than see it exploited.
You dare attack us! We took this land from the Elves ad we plan on staying here.
You are fools to attack us!

Finally our tower is free from these Orcs. I would thank you except you are pure evil. I feel obligated to help you out so listen there are markings that were constructed by a travelling Heretic I think that they are a source of power.

Once the witch hunters arrived they burned their foes. Prior to their passing the Witches vowed that they would give strength and heal all loyal to Mortis. Their burial ground is said to be the source of their power.
I think I can be of some help to you.
I think I can be of some help to you.
My wares can help you in your quest.
The one known as Gheros must be defeated. Gheros is a gate keeper of the mountains with his defeat the mountains shall fall.
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.
I have some powerful new spells that might interest you.
Gheros of the mountains must be destroyed. With the destruction of Gheros the mountains will fall one by one.
Take a look at my wares, I may have something of interest to you.
My Barbarians are the most formidable in the land.

Praise to the darkness that binds each of us. The land has two opposing groups of settlers. The Terrans and the Ice-Mar whom we know little about. We do know that the two groups of settlers hate one another. No matter to us we will destroy both of them.

We are to light the land on fire and destroy everyone. This land of magic will burn and become nothing more than a place of ash. With the land's power added to our own we will defeat those who oppose us!
There is talk in Grand Phantasy about the Vertigo. I do not know what this Vertigo is or how it will threaten the Legions Of The Damned.
The are whispers about the Vertigo. I wish to know what this Vertigo is and how it may threaten the Undead Hordes. There is something about this Vertigo that I don't understand.

The Phantasmals are undergoing a metamorphosis  of some sort. We Terrans have learned that the Vertigo spell has a side affect. Those who try to use the spell to destroy their enemies will become their enemies.
My brother is no more! With the aid of my Polar bear I will hunt down those responsible.

Lord Val of the Phantasmals is on a mission to destroy us! On the fortieth day he begins his journey to his city. We do not know where he is and what city he is travelling to. We must intercept this Phantasmal and stop him from completing his mission.
The Phantasmals are preparing an attack to destroy us. Their leader known as Lord Val is heading towards a city where he plans to destroy everyone. We must find and stop this man once and for all.
I warned you that your interference would lead us to take precautions. Now you shall feel our wrath!
Many of my people have fallen at your hands. Now the Terrans and yourself shall feel our might.

Behold the power of the Phantasmals. We will destroy all those who have invaded our home. The land that was once Grand Phantasy shall be rechristened Bedlam's Rapture. No one shall live except for the Phantasmals.
Lord Val is located in the western region. He is heavily protected by the Phantasmals. Lord Val must be defeated or we shall be destroyed by the Vertigo.
Lord Val is our immediate threat. He is in the north west region. Destroy so that we can avoid this Vertigo threat and continue with taking over the land.
We must find and defeat Lord Val before he destroys us all. We have ten days before he begins his final journey.
Lord Val begins his journey in ten days. We must find and defeat this man before he dooms us all.
We have two days until Lord Val begins his journey. If we do not stop him we will have failed our mission.
Two days is all that remains before Lord Val begins his journey. Should this journey be completed we will have failed our mission.
We have reason to believe that the Phantasmals will continue to attack us. We must be prepared to fight off the Phantasmals.
The Phantasmals are not going to surrender. We have reason to believe that the Phantasmals are preparing to take back their land.
On the fortieth day Lord Val begins his journey to Oracle Castle. Once Lord Val arrives he will unleash the Vertigo. To continue your quest Lord Val must  be stopped or everyone shall be defeated.

The ruling inhabitants the Phantasmals are preparing to counter attack. We don't know when or how. I have learned that the leader of the attack is Lord Val. I believe that it will be in our interest to find and defeat Lord Val.
Lord Val is the leader of the Phantasmals and he is a very resourceful person. I believe that it is in our interest to find this Phantasmal and destroy him.
The immediate threat is finally over. Now we can focus on our original mission. We will take over this land no one shall stop us!
The threat is over we have defeated Lord Val. Now we must concentrate on our original goal. The Undead Hordes shall take over this land and no one shall stop us!

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for his blood thirsts. It is said that he once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.
